subject: The fitted-bedroom journey from measure to installation
hook: One team, from first sketch to fitted doors
gbp:
Fitted wardrobes and bedroom furniture, made to measure for your room.

If you live in Newcastle-under-Lyme or anywhere around Stoke-on-Trent and your bedroom has awkward alcoves, a sloping ceiling or simply not enough hanging space, a fitted bedroom is built around those walls rather than fighting them.

What is included:
- A free, no-obligation design consultation to plan hanging, shelving and drawers around what you actually store
- A full measure of the room and an itemised quote, with transparent pricing and no hidden costs
- Manufacture in our own workshop in Hanley, with each piece quality-checked before it leaves
- Delivery and installation by our own team, including levelling and scribing to your walls

Finishes include matt, super matt, gloss, wood-effect and painted looks, with soft-close as standard. Everything arrives assembled — never flat-pack.

Book a free design consultation to get started.
